hub.metaTitle: Chat Generator for 11 Apps on iPhone & Android
hub.metaDescription: Free chat mockup and video ad maker for WhatsApp, iMessage, Instagram, Telegram, Snapchat, Messenger, TikTok, X, Signal, Discord and Viber. Export MP4 in your browser.
hub.h1: Chat generator for every app people text on
hub.intro: Pick an app, write the conversation, and Scenora renders it on a realistic iPhone or Samsung phone, then exports it as an MP4 video, GIF or image. Every app has its own iPhone and Android template rebuilt from the real 2026 design: bubbles, ticks, reactions, keyboards and all.

common.featuresHeading: What you can make with the {app} template
common.howHeading: How to make a {app} chat video
how: Open the studio with {app} selected, then choose iPhone or Samsung and light or dark mode.
Write the messages, or paste a chat transcript, or let ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini write the whole scenario with “Create with AI”.
Press play to watch it type out with the keyboard, then export an MP4 (9:16, 4:5, 1:1 or 16:9), a GIF or a still image.

faq.a: Yes. Scenora is free and open source. There is no sign-up and no watermark unless you add your own logo.

faq.q: Can I export the {app} chat as a video?
faq.a: Yes. Messages appear one by one with typing indicators, the on-screen keyboard and an optional auto-zoom camera, and you can export MP4, GIF or PNG/JPEG straight from your browser.
No. Editing, rendering and video encoding all happen in your browser, so your messages and images never leave your device.

faq.q: Can I use it to deceive people?
faq.a: Please don't. Scenora is for ads, tutorials, storytelling and design mockups. Never present a generated chat as a real conversation, and never impersonate a real person or brand.

whatsapp.metaTitle: WhatsApp Chat Generator for iPhone & Android
whatsapp.metaDescription: Make realistic WhatsApp chats and turn them into video ads. Blue ticks, voice notes, groups, reactions and the real keyboard on iPhone or Samsung. Free, in your browser.

Voice notes, photos with captions, stickers, locations, PDF files and call bubbles

Reactions, quoted replies, “Edited” labels, link previews and deleted messages
